ns2:course.label: Undergraduate Performance Practice
ns2:course.description: Performance laboratory involving the rehearsal and performance of student works under faculty supervision. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated. Prerequisite: For Dance majors. Dance minors may only enroll in this particular section: Senior Thesis Performance and Process Project.
